title: How many female clients' accounts are in the region of South Bohemia?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN ClientInfo AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
INNER JOIN ClientDistrict AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id
INNER JOIN district AS T5 ON T4.district_id = T5.district_id
WHERE T3.gender = 'F'
  AND T5.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
